watch.summary: A streamer confidently claims he was born to catch an incoming Rocket League shot, only to get immediately scored on and fall out of his chair laughing.

beats.what: Streamer repositions after a missed shot opportunity.
Streamer boasts 'I was born to catch this man' as the ball comes toward his net.
The opponent dunks the ball into his net instantly.
Streamer screams and collapses out of his chair in hysterics.

watch.author: creator
watch.key_line: I was born to catch this, man.
watch.why: The extreme hubris right before instant failure creates a perfect comedic timing beat. His dramatic physical reaction and shrieking laughter elevate a simple gameplay fail into a hilarious moment.
